about: Which uses each face file in this folder is licensed for, as DATA. An app build carries a face only when its licensed_for holds "app" (ios/carry-licensed-faces.sh, a build phase of every Apple target that draws a title, reads this file); otherwise the app draws that role with the system face (LookFaces in ios/Shared/Look.swift, the first family the device has). A face goes into apps by one edit here (a bought licence, or the person's own choice recorded in chosen_by): add the use to licensed_for and keep the receipt named in receipt; no code changes. test/licensed-faces.test.mjs refuses a face file this file does not name and any Apple project that bundles a face file directly.

faces.note: Trillion's own title face, made from Fraunces (The Fraunces Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1) and tuned towards Recoleta: SOFT 75, WONK 0, opsz 48 at weights 330, 450 and 580, side bearings narrowed to Recoleta's fit, the x-height raised to Recoleta's and Recoleta's line height. The OFL lets it be used, changed and carried in apps and pages; its notice travels in each file's name table and in Trillion-OFL.txt beside them.

The person chose Recoleta and accepted the licence risk himself (2026-10-06); no AI removes it or asks to buy it. The files came from a free-font site; a Latinotype licence or an original Trillion face drawn alike are optional later choices, never a gate.

chosen_by.words: The owner picked Recoleta, is fine with the foundry noticing it is used, and accepts the consequences.

faces.note: Apple's system face. Its licence covers designing for Apple's platforms, not carrying the file; every Apple device already draws it as the system font, so an app never needs the file.
